import os, sys, copy
import torch, torch.distributed as dist, torch.multiprocessing as mp
import torch.nn.functional as F
from transformers import LlamaConfig, LlamaForCausalLM
from pipeline_parallel import train_step_pipeline_afab


def run(rank, ws, attn, port):
    os.environ["MASTER_ADDR"] = "127.0.0.1"; os.environ["MASTER_PORT"] = str(port)
    dist.init_process_group("gloo", rank=rank, world_size=ws)
    torch.manual_seed(0)
    cfg = LlamaConfig(vocab_size=100, hidden_size=32, intermediate_size=64, num_hidden_layers=5,
                      num_attention_heads=4, num_key_value_heads=2, max_position_embeddings=64)
    cfg._attn_implementation = attn
    model = LlamaForCausalLM(cfg).float()
    ref = copy.deepcopy(model)
    g = torch.Generator().manual_seed(1)
    inputs = [torch.randint(0, 100, (2, 8), generator=g) for _ in range(3)]
    targets = [torch.randint(0, 100, (2, 8), generator=g) for _ in range(3)]
    loss = train_step_pipeline_afab(model, inputs, targets, torch.device("cpu"), torch.float32)
    for x, y in zip(inputs, targets):
        logits = ref(x).logits
        (F.cross_entropy(logits.reshape(-1, 100), y.reshape(-1)) / 3).backward()
    maxdiff, n = 0.0, 0
    for (name, p), (_, q) in zip(model.named_parameters(), ref.named_parameters()):
        if p.grad is not None:
            n += 1
            maxdiff = max(maxdiff, (p.grad - q.grad).abs().max().item())
    print(f"ws={ws} attn={attn} rank={rank} params_with_grad={n} maxdiff={maxdiff:.2e} loss={loss}")
    dist.destroy_process_group()


if __name__ == "__main__":
    port = 29500
    for attn in ["eager", "sdpa"]:
        for ws in [1, 2]:
            port += 1
            mp.spawn(run, args=(ws, attn, port), nprocs=ws)
